description.en: You arrive at a shopping mall to find an unresponsive middle-aged male collapsed on the floor. Bystanders report he suddenly fell.
description.tl: Kayo ay dumating sa shopping mall upang mahanap ang isang unresponsive middle-aged male na nabagsak sa sahig. Ang mga bystanders ay nag-report na biglang siya ay nahulog.

initialVitals.notes: Patient appears unresponsive with no pulse or respiration detected

decision.en: Check for scene safety and call for AED
decision.tl: Suriin ang scene safety at tawagan para sa AED

feedback.en: Correct! Scene safety is always first. Requesting AED and activating EMS response.
feedback.tl: Tama! Ang scene safety ay laging una. Nag-request ng AED at nag-activate ng EMS response.

nextDecision.tl: Ano ang iyong susunod na gawin?

text.tl: Magsimula ng CPR na may 30 chest compressions

text.en: Wait for the AED before doing anything
text.tl: Maghintay para sa AED bago gumawa ng kahit ano

outcome.en: Good decision-making! CPR was started immediately, and when AED arrived, defibrillation was performed. Patient was resuscitated and transported to the nearest hospital.
outcome.tl: Magandang decision-making! Ang CPR ay nagsimula agad, at kapag dumating ang AED, ang defibrillation ay ginanap. Ang patient ay na-resuscitate at dinala sa nearest hospital.

learningPoints.en: Scene safety must be assessed first
learningPoints.tl: Ang scene safety ay dapat ma-assess muna
Ang early CPR ay nagpapabuti ng survival outcomes

learningPoints.en: AED should be used as soon as available
learningPoints.tl: Ang AED ay dapat gamitin hangga't available

title.tl: Motor Vehicle Accident na may Trauma

description.en: Multiple vehicle collision on a highway. You arrive to find two vehicles with visible damage and several injured persons.
description.tl: Multiple vehicle collision sa highway. Kayo ay dumating upang mahanap ang dalawang vehicles na may visible damage at maraming injured persons.

decision.en: Ensure scene safety and call for additional ambulances
decision.tl: Siguraduhin ang scene safety at tawagan para sa additional ambulances

feedback.en: Correct! Multiple casualties require additional resources and proper scene management.
feedback.tl: Tama! Ang multiple casualties ay nangangailangan ng additional resources at proper scene management.

nextDecision.en: How do you prioritize which patient to treat first?
nextDecision.tl: Paano mo prioritize kung aling patient ang dapat tratuhin muna?

text.en: Use triage system - treat most critical first
text.tl: Gumamit ng triage system - tratuhin ang most critical muna

text.en: Treat in order of vehicle damage severity
text.tl: Tratuhin sa order ng vehicle damage severity

outcome.en: By using proper triage and resource management, all patients were appropriately prioritized and transported.
outcome.tl: Sa pamamagitan ng tamang triage at resource management, lahat ng patients ay appropriately na-prioritize at na-transport.

learningPoints.en: Scene safety is critical in MVAs
learningPoints.tl: Ang scene safety ay critical sa MVAs

learningPoints.en: Early mobilization of resources for mass casualties
learningPoints.tl: Ang early mobilization ng resources para sa mass casualties
Ang proper triage ay nagsasalba ng buhay

description.en: You are called to a residence where a 65-year-old female has sudden onset weakness on left side of body and slurred speech.
description.tl: Kayo ay tawagan sa isang residence kung saan ang isang 65-year-old female ay may sudden onset weakness sa left side ng katawan at slurred speech.

initialVitals.notes: Patient displays facial droop and speech difficulty

decision.en: Recognize stroke signs and immediately transport to stroke center
decision.tl: Kilalanin ang stroke signs at immediately i-transport sa stroke center

feedback.en: Excellent! Time is brain. Early recognition and transport to a stroke center is critical.
feedback.tl: Napakaganda! Ang time ay brain. Ang early recognition at transport sa stroke center ay critical.

text.en: Notify hospital of incoming stroke patient and time of symptom onset
text.tl: Inotify ang hospital ng incoming stroke patient at time ng symptom onset

outcome.en: By recognizing stroke symptoms early and notifying the hospital, the patient was able to receive thrombolytic therapy within the treatment window.
outcome.tl: Sa pamamagitan ng pagkilala sa stroke symptoms nang maaga at pag-notify sa hospital, ang patient ay nakagawa ng thrombolytic therapy sa treatment window.

learningPoints.en: F.A.S.T. - Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call
learningPoints.tl: F.A.S.T. - Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call

learningPoints.en: Time is critical in stroke treatment
learningPoints.tl: Ang time ay critical sa stroke treatment
Ang pre-hospital notification ay nagpapabuti ng patient outcomes
